Henry Adams, Democracy.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/henry-adams/democracy

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Henry Adams, an author, died 1918.

First publication of the text used: 1880 (SE colophon: 'Democracy was published in 1880 by Henry Adams.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1880. The edition's own statement of rights (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person named above died in 1918 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
